title: Distinguished-triangle package for the finite-free scalar projection
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Λ, a short complex S of point Λ-modules with specified finite biproduct identifications of its first two terms, a scheme morphism f:X→Y, and a derived coefficient K on X, there exist distinguished triangles T and T′ in the derived category over Y and a morphism φ:T→T′ whose first two components are isomorphisms, whose third objects are the source and target of the scalar-first projection after the stated object equalities, and whose transported third component is exactly the projection defined using modelPull.

source.place: Finite free and finitely presented coefficient extensions: unit, finite sums, and a cone; Stacks Tag 0944

proof.text: The projection mate is exact in the coefficient variable by the ringed projection-mate exactness theorem. Its component on the tensor unit is the identity, and additivity carries this to each specified finite biproduct. Apply the transformation to the mapping-cone triangle of S.f after exact point pullback. The first two components are isomorphisms, the image triangles are distinguished, and the third component is the scalar-first projection after the normalized modelPull comparison and the canonical tensor braiding.

The mapping-cone triangle is distinguished and its image under the exact tensor/direct-image composites is distinguished; the component identities and the projection identification are preserved by the cone comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFreeScalarProjection_triangle
    (Λ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) (S : ShortComplex (PointModules Λ)) (r : ℕ)
    (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ biproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ Mod.regular Λ.X))
    (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ biproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ Mod.regular Λ.X))
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X X)) :
    ∃ (T T' : Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X Y)))
      (φ : T ⟶ T'),
      T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X Y)) ∧
      T' ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X Y)) ∧
      T.obj₃ = DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Y) ⊗
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ.X f).obj K ∧
      T'.obj₃ = (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ.X f).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S X) ⊗ K) ∧
      IsIso φ.hom₁ ∧ IsIso φ.hom₂ ∧
      ∀ (hY : T.obj₃ = DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Y) ⊗
          (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ.X f).obj K)
        (hX : T'.obj₃ = (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ.X f).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S X) ⊗ K)),
        eqToHom hY.symm ≫ φ.hom₃ ≫ eqToHom hX =
          projection Λ f (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Y))
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S X)) (modelPull Λ S f) K
